mentions.name: Goalpost
mentions.description: This is a team-based system for managing project requirements of any sort, focused on software and product managers. Projects are lightly structured documents that can show what changed in any particular update and can be searched or browsed as an up-to-date spec. Changes live in batches with optional customizable approval rules, email notifications to stakeholders when requirements change, and the ability to move changes between batches pre-approval.
mentions.problem: Ticket or chat-based workflows lose tons of context over time, and during rapid iteration even the tickets themselves can't keep up with changes in requirements.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building www.movegoalpost.com. It’s a team based system for managing project requirements of any sort, but I’m focusing on software and product managers since it’s a segment I know.
